contact.address: VIP Road, Siripuram, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India

descriptions.hero_desc: Bespoke interior architectural solutions tailored to blend luxury, comfort, and timeless modern style.
descriptions.about_desc_1: At Creative Interiors, we believe that design should transcend aesthetics. A space is a sanctuary, a reflection of individual identity, and a functional work of art.
descriptions.about_desc_2: Founded by CEO & Principal Designer Balivada Ravi Kumar, our Visakhapatnam-based firm brings together highly curated materials, meticulous layout planning, and organic modern textures to establish environments that feel both inspiring and deeply comforting.
descriptions.footer_desc: Founded by Balivada Ravi Kumar, our award-winning Visakhapatnam firm creates balanced, beautiful, and highly personalized spaces.
descriptions.booking_desc: Let's discuss your space. Fill out our detailed brief questionnaire to schedule a virtual or on-site consultation with our lead designers.

testimonials.quote: Creative Interiors transformed our outdated villa in Rushikonda into a warm, sunlit modern sanctuary. They completely understood our vision, and the execution is flawless.
testimonials.author: Ananya & Rohan Sharma

testimonials.quote: The design of our corporate office on VIP Road is a huge success. The team created an inspiring commercial workspace that our clients and partners rave about daily.
testimonials.author: Kabir Malhotra

testimonials.quote: Their choice of organic, local materials and balanced layouts was absolutely flawless. The craftsmanship is of international standards.
testimonials.author: Priya Nair
